title: Person trapped or crushed under debris
scenario: Person pinned, stuck, or crushed under a wall, furniture, bookcase, or rubble after collapse. Cannot get out.
steps: Call 911 immediately and tell them a person is trapped.
If the object is small and can be lifted safely and the person was trapped only briefly, free them carefully.
If they have been pinned for a long time or the object is heavy, wait for professional rescuers — releasing a long-crushed limb without medical support can be fatal.
Control any bleeding you can reach with firm direct pressure.
Keep the person warm, still, and talking with you. Note how long they have been trapped and tell rescuers.
Watch for aftershocks and your own safety — do not become a second victim.
do_not: Do not yank a person free from heavy debris without medical rescuers present.
Do not leave them alone if you can safely stay.
